titles.title: From The Patio II

description: A brown adobe patio, supported by yellowish-brown beams, protrudes from the white walls of a house. A chimney emerges from the house's roof, extending into a bright blue sky. Vigas, round wooden support beams, stick out from the house's roof. A window offers a glimpse inside the structure.
